title: Personal Credit Cards: How Many Cards One Customer May Hold
content:
Piedmont Crescent Bank allows a customer to carry several Personal Credit Cards at once, subject to a portfolio ceiling, a rule against duplicate tiers and a bar that follows any charged-off card. Each test is decided from the bank's own card records for that customer, as they stand before a new application is recorded; what the customer says about other cards does not substitute for those records.

## Rule

1. At the time a new application would be recorded, the customer's cards that are pending approval, active or suspended must number fewer than 3.
2. The customer may not already have a card of the tier being requested in applied, active or suspended status; one card per tier is the limit.
3. Where any of the customer's card accounts stands charged off, no new card may be opened for that customer.
4. Closed card accounts play no part in any of these counts.

## Checklist before an application is taken

| Test | Evidence | Outcome when failed |
|---|---|---|
| Open, pending or suspended cards number fewer than 3 | the customer's card accounts and their statuses | the application is not recorded |
| No card of the same tier in applied, active or suspended status | the customer's card accounts, tiers and statuses | the application is not recorded |
| No card account in charged-off status | the customer's card accounts and statuses | no new card is opened |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- A customer holds an active Cash Rewards Visa, a suspended Secured Visa and a closed Platinum Low Rate Visa. Two accounts count, which is below 3, and no charged-off card exists, so an application for Travel Rewards Visa Signature can be recorded; a second Cash Rewards Visa could not, since one of that tier is already active.
- A customer whose only other card was charged off years ago and later closed by the bank still has an account that is not in charged-off status today; the bar looks at the current status of each account.
- A customer with three active cards cannot apply for a fourth, because a count of 3 is not below 3.
